cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.
